name: VAT Validator MCP
description: AI-powered VAT fraud detection and live VAT validation via EU VIES (27 member states), UK HMRC, and AU ABR. Call before invoice approval, supplier onboarding, or cross-border payment. Detects missing trader fraud, carousel fraud, deregistered entity re-use. Returns CLEAR/REVIEW/BLOCK verdict.

tools.name: validate_vat
tools.description: Validates a VAT number against EU VIES, UK HMRC, or AU ABR (auto-detected from the number's prefix) and runs AI fraud risk analysis in the same call. Returns PROCEED/VERIFY_MANUALLY/HOLD agent_action, CLEAR/REVIEW/BLOCK recommendation, fraud risk score 0-100, registered name, address.

tools.name: get_vat_rates
tools.description: Returns current standard and reduced VAT rates for all 27 EU member states, UK, and AU.
